newsitem.title: CROATIA: French banks finance rebuilding of Zadar airport.
newsitem.headline: French banks finance rebuilding of Zadar airport.

text.p: French banks Societe General and Banque Francais du Commerce Exterieur signed agreements to finance rebuilding and re-equipping war-damaged Zadar airport, Croatian news agency HINA reported.
It said Societe General granted the airport in tourist central Dalmatia 31.1 million French francs, to be repaid over five years at 7.0 percent.
The other loan was for 7.8 million francs also at seven-percent interest, with a repayment period of two years.

These are the first French bank loans for the reconstruction projects in Croatia. Both would be handled by Societe's new branch office in capital Zagreb. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
